name: platform_terrain
prompt: Original charming 2D retro pixel-art game assets for a child's kitten rescue game called Car Runaway. Warm dark brown outlines, readable pixel clusters, bright mint and lime grass, warm ochre earth and sandstone, gentle pastel woodland palette matching an adorable ginger kitten and floppy-eared brown dog. Strict SIDE VIEW as in a 2D Mario-like platformer, no isometric, no overhead, no 3D render, no perspective ground plane. No text, no labels, no watermark. A precise SOURCE SPRITE SHEET, square canvas, 4 columns x 4 rows, exactly 16 equally spaced isolated modules on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. All cells equal size; each module fills about 80% of its cell leaving generous transparent gutters. Every terrain module is a flat 2D square with straight matching side edges, crisp top horizontal walkable surface and equal scale. The matching grass top height and soil pattern level must be identical across the first row. Row 1 left to right: grass-topped earth LEFT outside edge block; grass-topped earth CENTER block; grass-topped earth RIGHT outside edge block; full brown earth interior fill block without grass. Row 2: earth LEFT vertical cliff wall block, earth RIGHT vertical cliff wall block, earth BOTTOM LEFT corner block, earth BOTTOM RIGHT corner block. Row 3: sandstone platform TOP LEFT edge block; sandstone platform TOP CENTER block; sandstone platform TOP RIGHT edge block; sandstone interior fill block. Row 4: sandstone LEFT vertical cliff block; sandstone RIGHT vertical cliff block; sandstone BOTTOM LEFT corner block; sandstone BOTTOM RIGHT corner block. Opaque square interiors; transparent outside square modules only. Distinct modules suitable for constructing continuous cliffs, not rounded floating islands. Texture shading gentle without cast shadows.
